body.name: Independent-root kill instance
body.construction: Take binary roots \(U_1,U_2\), binary observed nodes \(A,B,C\), and arrows \(U_1\to A,B\), \(U_2\to A,C\), \(A\to B\), and \(B\to C\); enumerate its \(2^{12}=4096\) deterministic response skeletons, all exact observed supports of size at most four, and the queries \(P_{A=a}(C=c)\).
